wikipulse-connecting: Status while connecting to the stream.
wikipulse-offline: Status when the stream cannot be reached.
wikipulse-stat-total: Label: edits seen since the page opened.
wikipulse-stat-wikis: Label: number of different wikis seen.
wikipulse-filter-kn: Filter button: Kannada Wikipedia. Keep it in Kannada script.
wikipulse-filter-tcy: Filter button: Tulu Wikipedia. Keep it in Kannada script.
wikipulse-feed: Heading of the list of latest edits.
wikipulse-top: Heading of the list of busiest wikis.
wikipulse-by:
Who made the edit.
